description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Fire with Stacking] to the user depending on entry damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000] and Crystal Mode to the user
Crystal Mode: Dark/Fire Ability Boost, Dualcast Dark/Fire, Zero Hone Cost to Dark/Fire Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: Single-target Dark/Fire/NE physical attack (10.00) at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [Physical +30% Boost 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2
description.text: Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
